Overview

CTF CICADA 2026 – Capture The Flag

Organised by IEEE Student Branch & IET On Campus, BIT Mesra

Get ready to enter the world of cryptic clues, hidden messages, ciphers, and challenging puzzles!

CTF CICADA 2026 brings back our Capture The Flag competition with an entirely new experience inspired by Cicada 3301, the mysterious internet puzzle phenomenon that captivated thousands of people worldwide.

This year, we are moving beyond the traditional Jeopardy-style CTF format and introducing an Alternate Reality Game (ARG)-style experience. Participants will navigate through 30 levels, each presenting a trail of clues that must be deciphered to unlock the next stage.

Whether you enjoy cryptography, cybersecurity, logical reasoning, digital investigation, or solving unconventional puzzles, CICADA is your opportunity to put your skills to the test.

Event Format

  • Competition: Capture The Flag (CTF)
  • Format: ARG-style, fully online
  • Total Levels: 30
  • Team Size: 1–3 members
  • Participation: Open across India
  • Duration: 10 December 2026 – 10 January 2027

What Makes CICADA Different?

Unlike conventional CTF competitions that present standalone challenges on a leaderboard, CICADA follows a progressive puzzle-solving journey.

  • 30 Progressive Levels: Every level contains a trail of clues. Solve one to unlock the next.
  • ARG-Inspired Challenges: Explore clues involving images, ciphers, websites, and hidden information.
  • Staged Releases: Levels will open in stages and remain accessible until the competition ends.
  • Hints Along the Way: Hints will be released to help participants progress.
  • No Elimination: Participants can continue solving challenges throughout the competition period.

Who Can Participate?

CICADA 2026 welcomes curious, analytical, and technically inclined participants from across India.

You can participate:

  • Individually, or
  • In a team of 2–3 members.

Bring your friends together, form a team, and take on the challenge.

Prizes and Recognition

  • Exciting prizes for the winning teams.
  • E-certificates for every participant.
  • Recognition for outstanding performance.

About the Organisers

IEEE Student Branch and IET On Campus at Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra, Ranchi, are student-run campus chapters of two leading engineering societies.

Since 2019, we have been organising Capture The Flag competitions, technical events, and hands-on workshops covering Linux, Git, Python, web development, and more.

With CICADA 2026, we aim to bring an engaging, month-long puzzle-solving experience to participants across India.

Important Dates

  • Competition Starts: 10 December 2026
  • Competition Ends: 10 January 2027
  • Mode: Completely Online
  • Get ready to decode, investigate, collaborate, and uncover what lies beyond the next clue.

Organised by:

IEEE Student Branch & IET On Campus
Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra, Ranchi

The trail is waiting. Will you follow it?

CTF CICADA 2026 – Every clue leads somewhere.
